items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. Who was in that handy, uh, John Lowe band? Any idea? I don't know.

ctx.x: No, no. Only a few days, didn't sell out.
Yeah. Who was in that handy, uh, John Lowe band? Any idea? I don't know.
I really don't know. You said I made the first record with him, Joe Rule. I don't remember the last record with him.
